LanguageData.Apparel_Faceplate.label: Advanced Faceplate

LanguageData.Apparel_Hockey_Mask.label: Hockey Mask
LanguageData.Apparel_Hockey_Mask.description: Nobody on the rim knows what or where these things originate from, but one thing they do know is, some of the savages nearby love to run around with these on ripping people to pieces....
LanguageData.Apparel_Leather_Faceplate.label: Faceplate
LanguageData.Apparel_Leather_Faceplate.description: A basic faceplate used to keep pawns faces intact, most commonly made of animal leather, but some choose to be a bit more erratic when choosing their ingredients....
